Row.Text: Fix controller input on Mac when menus work but the world map does not. Includes separate left- and right-stick direction settings. Configure in Options → Add-ons → Better Controller Support. Debug bar hidden by default.

Optional compatibility for map input and menu stick navigation. Off by default on every platform; previously saved preferences are preserved. Confirm applies the switch immediately. Turn it off to return to native input. Do not enable the standalone Mac fix at the same time.
Reverse vertical camera movement from the right stick. Change this if the camera moves in the opposite direction.
Show status, input event counts and quick switches at the top of the map. Hidden by default; enable only when troubleshooting. Also records a limited number of menu stick samples in UI.log.
Right-stick vertical movement is inverted. Click to change.
Right-stick vertical movement is not inverted. Click to change.
Your previous settings remain active. Check storage access and try again.

Reverse vertical map cursor movement and its camera-follow from the left stick. Off by default. If movement feels reversed, toggle this setting and confirm. Does not change menus, the D-pad or the right stick.

Use when the sticks have reversed roles. Swaps plot selection and camera control on the map, and focus navigation and scrolling in the main/pause menus, their subpages and small event-choice popups. Other in-game panels and D-pad are unchanged. Vertical inversion applies only to the map.
Controller settings could not be read

The saved controller settings are unavailable or invalid. Your last valid settings remain active for this UI session. If none have been loaded, native input is used. If multiple storage records exist, exit the game and migrate them from a verified backup before retrying. No other Mod settings have been cleared.
修复 Mac 上手柄能操作菜单、却无法操作地图的问题，可分别调整左右摇杆上下方向。可在“选项 → 附加内容 → 更好的手柄支持”调整，调试栏默认隐藏。
手动修复地图输入及菜单摇杆导航。各平台默认关闭，已有保存偏好会保留；确认后立即应用，关闭后恢复原生输入。请勿同时启用独立的旧 Mac 手柄修复。
翻转右摇杆控制镜头的上下方向。仅在方向与预期相反时调整。
在地图顶部显示状态、输入事件计数及快捷开关。默认隐藏，需要排查问题时再开启；开启后也会在 UI.log 记录少量菜单摇杆输入。
当前已翻转右摇杆上下，点击切换。
当前未翻转右摇杆上下，点击切换。
原有设置仍在生效，请检查存储权限后重试。
翻转左摇杆控制地图光标及镜头跟随的上下方向，默认关闭。如果方向与预期相反，切换此项并确认；不影响菜单、十字键和右摇杆。
左右摇杆职责反了时开启。交换地图中的地块选择／镜头，以及主菜单、暂停菜单、其子页面和小型事件选项弹窗的焦点移动／滚动。其他局内面板与十字键不变；上下翻转仅作用于地图，不影响菜单方向。
已保存的手柄设置无法读取或格式异常。本次界面会话继续使用最后有效设置；如果尚未读取过有效设置，则使用原生输入。若存在多条存储记录，请退出游戏后从核验过的备份迁移，再重试。未清空其他 Mod 的设置。
